name.value: A bill for an act to raise the top rate of the federal income tax.

inserted.value: Section 1. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled, That the tax rate on the highest bracket of taxable income shall be raised to the rate set here.

name.value: A bill for an act to let public money follow a child to a private school.

inserted.value: Section 1. Be it enacted by the Legislative Assembly of North Dakota, That public education money shall pay part of a child's tuition at a private school.

name.value: A bill for an act to give local governments wider power to govern themselves.

inserted.value: Section 1. Be it enacted by the Legislative Assembly of North Dakota, That a local government shall have the power to act on any matter the state has not reserved.

name.value: A bill for an act to repeal the law on criminal records on state job applications.

inserted.value: Section 1. Be it enacted by the Legislative Assembly of North Dakota, That the law now in force on criminal records on state job applications is repealed.

struck.value: Section 1. Be it enacted by the Legislative Assembly of North Dakota, That a state agency shall not ask about an applicant's criminal record on a first job application.

name.value: A bill for an act to raise the federal minimum wage.

inserted.value: Section 1. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled, That the federal minimum wage shall be raised to the amount set here.

what.value: is paid at least the new federal minimum wage

enforcer.value: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division

penalty.value: back wages and civil fines for the employer
